title: Leveraging uncertainty quantification to optimize CRISPR guide RNA selection
authors: Carl Schmitz, Jacob Bradford, Robert Salomone, Dimitri Perrin
relevance_to_cellguide: Directly on-topic for the plan's guide RANKING/selection problem (not just scoring): uses a deep-ensemble uncertainty-aware model to design guide selection STRATEGIES, achieving >90% precision. This is the closest match in the whole search to the plan's core deliverable ('multi-objective ranking... Top 3 guides + component scores + evidence') — worth reading in full if the team wants a template for combining prediction uncertainty into a ranking policy rather than a single score.
